M00.reason: The current Logos module/Basecamp development path is locally verified on macOS Apple Silicon. The official chained doctest reported 50/57 passes, but all 7 failures collapsed to one NO_DAEMON condition. Manual reproductions then verified Basecamp, logoscore daemon startup, config emission, module discovery/load/introspection, factorial(5)=120, fibonacci(10)=55, libVersion=1.0.0, clean shutdown, LOGOSCORE_CONFIG_DIR behavior, and Python subprocess shell-background execution. The remaining anomaly is isolated to the specific original doctest run context and is non-blocking.
M00.next: No blocking work. Keep ProofForge issue #3 as optional upstream-tooling follow-up unless the same problem affects LP-0018 implementation or CI.
